Business Unit
Cloud & Smart Industries Group (CSIG) is responsible for promoting the company's cloud and industry Internet strategy. CSIG explores the interactions between users and industries to create innovative solutions for smart industries via technological advancements such as cloud, AI, and network security. While driving the digitalization of retail, medical, education, transportation and other industries, CSIG helps companies serve users in smarter ways, building a new ecosystem of intelligent industries that connect users and businesses.

What the Role Entails
Position Overview
Tencent Cloud is seeking a Network Procurement Business Manager to drive carrier network resource expansion and strategic partnership development. This role focuses on network node site selection, early-stage technical coordination, commercial negotiation and execution for resource deployment, and ongoing partnership management with telecom operators and suppliers. You will serve as the primary commercial interface for regional carriers, help drive network resource implementation, and coordinate cross-functional collaboration across planning, network, and operations teams to support stable service delivery and long-term business growth.
Responsibilities
Lead commercial development for carrier network resources aligned with company planning, including network node site selection and evaluation, early-stage technical coordination, commercial negotiation for resource deployment, contract execution, and billing/payment management throughout the full commercial lifecycle.
Act as the primary commercial interface for telecom operators in the assigned region, building and maintaining long-term strategic partnerships to support business growth and advance carrier cooperation initiatives.
Serve as the primary point of contact between the company and telecom operators or suppliers, establishing effective communication channels across planning, network, and operations teams to drive resolution of operational issues and optimization requests during service delivery.
Drive the implementation of network resource projects and ensure alignment between internal stakeholders and external partners throughout the delivery process.
Provide market intelligence and actionable recommendations on carrier engagement, procurement strategy, and industry developments within the IDC/CDN ecosystem.

Who We Look For
Bachelor's degree or above and a minimum of 3 years of relevant experience in infrastructure, telecom, or cloud-related environments.
Technical background in IDC, networking, or cloud infrastructure, with practical experience collaborating with telecom operators, cloud providers, or large-scale internet companies, including CDN experience.
Strong understanding of peering, routing optimization, and interconnection models in carrier or IDC environments.
Proven commercial negotiation skills, with experience managing cross-border carrier or infrastructure partnerships across Southeast Asia.
Excellent written and spoken English is required. Proficiency in Mandarin Chinese is also required, as approximately 50% of the role involves collaboration with Tencent's headquarters in China for business discussions, meetings, and documentation.
Familiarity with contract structures and basic legal considerations in commercial negotiations. Relevant cloud or networking certifications are a plus. Willingness to travel frequently across Southeast Asia.

Equal Employment Opportunity at Tencent
As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.
Work Location: Singapore-CapitaSky

仕事内容/What the Role Entails
Tencent Cloud is expanding its international media services business, helping OTT, social, gaming, education, and enterprise customers build and scale audio and video experiences on global cloud infrastructure. As a new-graduate Media Services Solution Architect based in Tokyo, you will join the regional architecture team supporting the Japan market — owning pre-sales technical consultation and PoC verification for customers, shaping industry solutions, and acting as the technical voice of Tencent Cloud Media Services with customers, partners, and the product organization.Work closely with the regional sales team as the technical point of contact for Japanese customers in the audio and video domain, delivering pre-sales technical consultation and hands-on PoC verification.
Analyze customers' media business technology architectures and identify their needs and success criteria across OTT, social media, gaming, education, and enterprise scenarios, translating them into solution designs.
Design and deliver industry solutions and case studies for the Japanese and international markets by combining customer business and technical requirements with the capabilities of Tencent Cloud's media products.
Represent customer and industry requirements to the product development team, ensuring Japan market needs are clearly communicated and reflected in the product roadmap.
Present Tencent Cloud media capabilities, industry experience, and insights at online and offline product and industry events, and support the channel and marketing teams through partner enablement training, workshops, and Media Demo Day.

応募資格/Who We Look For
Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, information technology, cloud computing, or a related field, graduating by March 2027 (or completed within the past 12 months).
Professional fluency in Japanese and English, written and spoken, including public speaking and solution document writing; Mandarin Chinese is a plus.
Solid understanding of audio and video technologies such as live streaming, video on demand, encoding and decoding, and network transmission.
Strong customer orientation and service mindset, with the ability to engage technical decision-makers and express complex architectures in business terms.
Ability to collaborate across cultures with regional sales, architecture, product, and channel teams, and willingness to travel within Japan and occasionally across APAC; internship or project experience with a public cloud platform or the media and streaming industry is a plus.
